How this works

  1. The robot reads news feeds all day and gives every story a score.
  2. The best stories wait in To review below, and arrive as cards in Telegram.
  3. Each card has five yes/no checks. Approve only works when all five are yes.
  4. Tap Approve in Telegram: the story and its sources reach the website in about 5 minutes. You can undo for 10 minutes.
  5. Breaking shows a red banner on the site. Live shows updates you approve one by one. Nothing goes out without your tap.
